memories.content: The chair has decided to step down and will announce this at the upcoming annual general meeting. They have not yet identified a successor and are not actively recruiting one.

The Kettlewell allotment society holds an annual general meeting in five weeks, at which nominations for chair will close. The current chair is stepping down, and the position will be vacant unless someone volunteers.
